new_terms.label: Order-book sequence gap
new_terms.summary_strategy: Missing ordered source-position evidence invalidates book reconstruction and any execution state derived across the gap.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Do not use this label for candle coverage, runner liveness, or overlay projection gaps.
new_terms.alias_handling: No alias, deprecation, replacement, or adoption is proposed by this batch.

new_terms.label: Runner clock gap / overlay clock gap
new_terms.summary_strategy: Runner-liveness gaps and overlay-projection gaps are distinct failure domains with different consequences.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Neither label denotes missing source candles or an order-book sequence gap.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates contrasted concepts; it is not an adopted synonym relationship.

new_terms.label: Book Validity Interval
new_terms.summary_strategy: An explicit interval over which reconstructed book state remains causally available and valid.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Avoid generic valid-interval wording and do not imply validity beyond known closures.
new_terms.alias_handling: No alias, deprecation, replacement, or adoption is proposed by this batch.

new_terms.label: Live runtime/composition
new_terms.summary_strategy: A live label may denote an active lifecycle or reserved composition seam without external venue-trading authority.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Live runtime or composition never means authorized external order submission.
new_terms.alias_handling: Lifecycle and composition uses remain qualified, not adopted as interchangeable aliases.

new_terms.label: Provider ID / Venue ID / exchange slug
new_terms.summary_strategy: Provider identity selects a provider contract, venue identity selects a market route, and exchange slug remains an adapter-facing translation.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Provider, venue, datasource, and exchange fields are not interchangeable authority.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates distinct identities; no alias relationship is adopted.

new_terms.label: Canonical Instrument / provider product identity
new_terms.summary_strategy: Canonical Instrument is platform identity; symbols and provider product identifiers are routed external identities resolved against it.
new_terms.usage_boundary: A display symbol or provider product identifier is not a globally stable instrument key.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates platform and provider-facing concepts; no equivalence is adopted.

new_terms.label: Enrollment / collector operation
new_terms.summary_strategy: Enrollment admits reviewed definitions; an operation requests lifecycle intent against already admitted configuration.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Enrollment neither starts a collector nor proves production readiness by itself.
new_terms.alias_handling: Enrollment and operation remain contrasted concepts, not aliases.

new_terms.label: Reconstructed Book State / book checkpoint / execution-book tape
new_terms.summary_strategy: Book state is disposable reconstruction, a checkpoint accelerates replay, and an execution-book tape is a frozen certified runtime input.
new_terms.usage_boundary: A checkpoint or tape is not provider truth, and current book state is not Dataset truth.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates distinct evidence artifacts; no synonym or replacement is adopted.

new_terms.label: Overlay contract / overlay snapshot / overlay delta
new_terms.summary_strategy: An overlay contract defines renderable semantics, a snapshot is full current visual state, and a delta is bounded projection transport with its own clock.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Overlay artifacts are projections, never Strategy inputs or canonical execution state.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates distinct contract and transport forms; no alias is adopted.

new_terms.label: Signal ID / Decision ID / order and fill IDs
new_terms.summary_strategy: Distinct causal identities link signal, decision, order request, attempt, event, and fill artifacts without aliasing them.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Shared provenance never makes these identifiers the same object or clock.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates distinct causal identities; no alias is adopted.

new_terms.label: Instrument Execution Profile
new_terms.summary_strategy: A compatibility compiler/input for instrument execution fields used to resolve the immutable run-scoped execution context.
new_terms.usage_boundary: It is not provider metadata, a Strategy setting, external-order authority, or the final owner of venue and fee semantics.
new_terms.alias_handling: Do not alias the profile to Resolved Execution Context; their accepted ownership roles differ.

new_terms.label: Resolved Execution Context / context bundle
new_terms.summary_strategy: An immutable per-series binding of independently versioned execution contracts; a run bundle pins one context per runtime series.
new_terms.usage_boundary: The context binds execution assumptions but does not own Strategy meaning, accounting settlement, or authorization.
new_terms.alias_handling: Resolved context and context bundle remain related but distinct scopes, not interchangeable aliases.

new_terms.label: Runtime Execution Plan / Canonical Order Request
new_terms.summary_strategy: A runtime execution plan is intended action; a canonical order request begins durable order quantity and policy custody.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Neither artifact is a fill, and the plan is not the durable order lifecycle.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates adjacent lifecycle artifacts; no alias or replacement is adopted.

new_terms.label: Canonical Order Lifecycle / FillOrder / fill
new_terms.summary_strategy: Canonical lifecycle is durable append-only order truth, FillOrder is a compatibility request adapter, and a fill is one executed-quantity event.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Never describe FillOrder as the durable order or one fill as the whole order.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates distinct lifecycle concepts; no alias or replacement is adopted.

new_terms.label: Wallet state / Wallet Ledger fact / wallet commit clock
new_terms.summary_strategy: Wallet state is current capital truth, ledger facts are replayable transitions, and wallet_commit_seq orders shared-wallet mutation.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Runtime publication order and Report or BotLens wallet views are not alternate wallet truth.
new_terms.alias_handling: The slash separates current state, durable facts, and an ordering clock; no alias is adopted.

new_terms.label: Qualified Cursor
new_terms.summary_strategy: Run sequence, websocket replay cursor, overlay commit sequence, position commit sequence, wallet commit sequence, and trade revision are separately qualified ordered positions.
new_terms.usage_boundary: Bare cursor or sequence wording must not invite comparison across independent clocks.
new_terms.alias_handling: No clock or cursor alias, deprecation, replacement, or adoption is proposed by this batch.
